evidence.document: Semtech 1N4148W marking and SOD-123 drawing review

marking.appearance_status: W1 is the code shown in the Semtech datasheet; typeface, placement and finish are illustrative.

recipe.appearance_status: KiCad SOD-123 model is 3.8 x 1.6 x 1.26 mm overall, with a cathode stripe on the pin-1 side. Its height exceeds the Semtech drawing maximum by 0.11 mm. The source 10 x 5 mm dimensions appear to be placeholders and no footprint is selected. Fine details are approximate; not manufacturing CAD.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
